info.title: XMesh Nexus Integration API
info.summary: Full VPN control-plane API for Telegram bots and independent integrations
info.description: Mixed shipped and proposed Integration API operations. Check the x-rollout-status of each method and the docs/integrations/README.md for the authoritative rollout status. Payments, tariffs, checkouts and customer notifications belong to external applications; VPN accounts, subscriptions and quotas belong to Nexus. Documentation does not itself establish production availability.

get.summary: Find all visible VPN subscriptions for a Telegram user ID
get.description: Matches legacy panel field data.tg. Supports multiple VPN accounts per Telegram ID; requires both telegram:read and users:read. Results are restricted by allowedUserIds, and the cursor is HMAC-bound to the integration client and this Telegram ID. No raw credentials are returned.

patch.summary: Assign Telegram ID to an account created by this integration client
patch.description: One-way assignment only: requires telegram:assign and object access, a current If-Match and Idempotency-Key. The account must have been provisioned by this exact integration client. A previously populated Telegram ID, or a panel-created account, cannot be reassigned by an integration token. Panel owner handles disputes and rebinds.

post.summary: Атомарное идемпотентное продление на N дней
post.description: Продление в одной PostgreSQL-транзакции с записью дедупликации, связанной со стабильным интеграционным клиентом. Повтор после сбоя не начисляет дни дважды. Отложенный holdDays увеличивается без старта таймера до подтверждённого VPN-подключения. Неограниченный срок не превращается в конечный без отдельного явного изменения.

IntegrationBearer.description: Authorization: Bearer ...; no session cookies, tokens in URL, or shared admin login. Hash token at rest; revocation and expiry checked on each request.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: One immutable UUID per logical operation. Durable deduplication across restarts and token rotation; different payload is HTTP 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Use ETag version of resource to prevent lost concurrent updates.

UserCreate.description: Every new account requires either hold=true with holdDays or an explicit future expireAtMs. Credentials and usage cannot be supplied.

telegramId.description: Trusted Telegram Bot API from.id as a canonical decimal string; requires telegram:assign in addition to users:create

sourceReference.description: Opaque order reference, no payments or prices stored in Nexus

url.description: Bearer secret: subscriptions:read only; never in logs or generic user view

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details; no secrets or stack traces

x-security-invariants: 256-bit random secret hashed at rest and never logged
strict scope checks on every object and property
owner-only session-bound token provisioning and revocation
separate high privilege service role and short-lived approval for destructive actions
durable cross-token-rotation idempotency for entitlement grants
no Stripe/Telegram payment responsibilities in Nexus
signed cursor pagination; bounded output; strict allowlists
signed webhook outbox and SSRF-protected delivery
Redis rate limits fail closed; audited requests; redacted structured logs
